design_overview: A clean, modern task management application designed with clarity and usability at its core. The interface uses a card-based layout with clear visual hierarchy, emphasizing primary actions like task creation and completion. The design follows mobile-first principles with touch-friendly components, intuitive navigation, and a calming color palette that reduces cognitive load. Each screen serves a specific purpose in the task management workflow, from viewing all tasks to creating new ones and managing individual task details.

typography.font_family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

screens.name: Task List
screens.purpose: Display all user tasks with filtering options and quick actions for task management

key_components.name: App Header
key_components.styling: White background with subtle bottom border, contains app title 'My Tasks' in bold xlarge text, and user profile icon on right
key_components.interaction: Static header, profile icon navigates to Profile screen

key_components.name: Filter Tabs
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable tabs with rounded pill-shaped buttons, active tab has primary color background, inactive tabs have light gray background
key_components.interaction: Tap to filter tasks by 'All', 'Active', or 'Completed' status

key_components.name: Task Count Badge
key_components.styling: Small rounded badge showing number of tasks, positioned next to filter tabs, uses secondary color
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, displays current task count

key_components.name: Task Card - Incomplete

key_components.interaction: Tap card to view task details, tap checkbox to mark complete, swipe left to reveal delete action

key_components.name: Task Card - Complete
key_components.styling: White rounded card with reduced opacity, checked checkbox with success color, strikethrough text on title, green left border accent
key_components.interaction: Tap card to view details, tap checkbox to unmark, swipe left to delete

key_components.name: Checkbox
key_components.styling: 24px circular checkbox with border, filled with success color when checked, contains checkmark icon
key_components.interaction: Toggle task completion status

key_components.name: Empty State Illustration
key_components.styling: Centered illustration showing clipboard with checkmark, displayed when no tasks exist, with supporting text below
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, prompts user to create first task

key_components.name: Create Task FAB
key_components.styling: Floating action button, circular, 56px diameter, primary color background with white plus icon, positioned bottom-right with 16px margin, elevated shadow
key_components.interaction: Tap to navigate to Create Task screen

key_components.name: Task List Container
key_components.styling: Scrollable vertical list with 12px spacing between cards, 16px horizontal padding
key_components.interaction: Scroll to view all tasks, pull down to refresh

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar with white background, three evenly spaced items with icons and labels, active item uses primary color
key_components.interaction: Navigate between main app sections

screens.user_flow: Entry point of the app. Users land here after login, can filter tasks, tap cards to view details, use FAB to create new tasks, or navigate to Profile via bottom nav or header icon.

key_components.styling: Small gray text showing character count for description, positioned below description input
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, updates as user types

key_components.name: Form Container

responsive_design: The application follows a mobile-first responsive design approach. On mobile devices (320px-768px), components stack vertically with full-width layouts and touch-optimized spacing (minimum 44px touch targets). On tablets (768px-1024px), the layout uses a two-column grid for task lists and wider modals (max-width 480px). On desktop (1024px+), the app centers with a maximum width of 1200px, task cards display in a grid (2-3 columns), and hover states become more prominent. Navigation adapts from bottom bar on mobile to side navigation on desktop. All interactive elements maintain minimum 44x44px touch targets across devices. Font sizes scale proportionally using rem units, and spacing uses a consistent 4px/8px grid system.
accessibility: The application implements WCAG 2.1 AA standards. All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets and proper focus indicators with 2px primary color outlines. Color contrast ratios meet 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text. All images include descriptive alt text, and icons are accompanied by text labels. Form inputs have associated labels and error messages are announced to screen readers. Semantic HTML is used throughout (header, nav, main, button elements). Keyboard navigation is fully supported with logical tab order and visible focus states. ARIA labels are applied to icon-only buttons and dynamic content updates. The app supports screen readers with proper heading hierarchy (h1-h3) and landmark regions. Error messages are clear, specific, and provide guidance for correction. Success and error states use both color and icons to convey meaning.
animations: Animations are subtle and purposeful, enhancing usability without causing distraction. Screen transitions use a 300ms ease-in-out slide animation (new screens slide from right, back navigation slides to right). Modal appearances use a 200ms fade-in with slight scale-up (0.95 to 1.0). Button interactions include a 150ms scale-down on press (0.98) and ripple effect on tap. Checkbox toggles animate with a 200ms spring animation. Task completion triggers a subtle strikethrough animation (300ms) and opacity change. List items have a 150ms hover lift effect (2px translateY). Loading states use a smooth skeleton shimmer animation. The FAB has a gentle bounce on first appearance and rotates 45° when active. Pull-to-refresh shows a smooth spinner animation. All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion settings and disable for users who prefer reduced motion. Micro-interactions like input focus use 200ms transitions for border color changes.
icons: The application uses a consistent icon system based on Feather Icons or similar minimal line-icon sets. Icons are 24px by default, scaling to 20px for compact contexts and 32px for prominent actions. All icons use a 2px stroke width for visual consistency. The icon set includes: home (house outline), plus (add new), user (person silhouette), settings (gear), edit (pencil), trash (bin), search (magnifying glass), filter (funnel), bell (notification), bookmark (ribbon), heart (favorite), share (arrow), and checkmark (completion). Icons are always paired with text labels except in bottom navigation where labels appear below icons. Icon colors match their context: primary color for active states, gray for inactive, white for buttons with colored backgrounds, success/error colors for status indicators. Icons are implemented as SVG for crisp rendering at any size and support theming.
